sentences.text:
THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 482 CR.P.C (U/S 528 BNSS)
PRAYING TO QUASH THE ENTIRE REGISTRATION OF FIR AND COMPLAINT AGAINST PETITIONER IN CR.NO.279/2023,
PENDING ON THE FILE OF 37th ACMM COURT, BENGALURU,
FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/S 498(A),504,506 OF IPC, U/S 3 AND 4 OF DP ACT.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE HEMANT CHANDANGOUDAR  ORAL ORDER The petitioner who is facing investigation for the offence punishable under sections 498A, 504, 506 of IPC, and under section 4 and 5 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. The allegation against the petitioner -accused is that, he is husband of the complainant and he subjected her to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and a demand was made to bring money from her parental home.

3. The parties are present before this Court and the petitioner has enclosed the copy of the application filed under section 482 r/w 320 (8) of Cr.P.C., for compounding of the offences stating that they have resolved the dispute and in terms of the settlement, their marriage has been dissolved and respondent No.2 has agreed to withdraw all the allegation, and she has no objection for quashing the impugned FIR.
NC: 2025:KHC:9410 4.
The application is placed on record.

5. Though the offences alleged against the petitioner are cognizable and non-compoundable,
however having regard to the fact the parties have settled the dispute between themselves, and it would be a futile exercise to subject the petitioner to an investigation, since the probability of police filing the charge sheet is remote and bleak in view of the settlement arrived between the parties.
Therefore, continuation of the investigation against the petitioner would amounts to abused of the process of law.
